text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go to the city on my day off to get a look
at something that I think
might cheer
Kawakami Princess up.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly an exasperated sigh grabs my
attention—it's her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! Trainer?! What are you doing
here?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah... of course I am! It's horrible!
The way that bully behaved
was the worst!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She was just like this character in Princess
Fighter... the leader of the
Dark
Umamusume, Dark Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I lost to her... This isn't just
a bad ending, it's
downright depressing!
I've been demoted from princess to frog!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess is more upset about her
loss than I thought. The
place I came to
check out should be of help though.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hm? And where is that?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: WHOOOA!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this poster... It's for the very first
Princess Fighter movie!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But why... It came out years ago!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So you mean... we can actually watch
Princess Fighter right now? On
the big
screen?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Woohoooo! This is great!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's really the best, Trainer! What're we
waiting for? Let's get our
tickets!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think it's working!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaah... That was so moving!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I loved it! The first movie will always be the best one! It was so exciting I thought I was going to break my armrests off!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, like that scene where the princess is
surrounded by a billion Dark
Umamusume
troops but escapes orbit by following the
prince's light
signal!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Or the scene at the moon racetrack where
she and the prince purify
the Dark Nebula
Emperor after he fused with the black
hole! I could
watch it a million times!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was such fun... Really...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A real princess and her prince have to
make incredible things like that
happen,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But when it came to it, I got wrecked by
Dark
Princess—well—someone just like
Dark Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm not fit to be a princess. The furthest I'll
ever get is background
extra...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh? What other scene?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Right before... Where the princess and
trainer are about to enter the
race that'll
decide the fate of the planet?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Before the final battle, when
things are at their darkest, the
princess
and trainer have one last talk...

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text:
Could this truly be the end for us? Is there
no way to save the
planet?!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, there's still a way... There's one last
race for us to finish!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, there's still a way... There's one last
race for us to finish!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me, Princess. We already know
that no matter how much we
struggle, we
can't pull off a miracle on our own...
unless!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me, Princess. We already know
that no matter how much we
struggle, we
can't pull off a miracle on our own...
unless!

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text:
We embrace our strengths and
weaknesses... And we combine our

differences...

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Then our power will far exceed our normal
capabilities. That... that is
what makes a
real miracle!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Then our power will far exceed our normal
capabilities. That... that is
what makes a
real miracle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
("So let's go... to the race of our destiny!"
Oooh, the most famous
scene in the
movie!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
("So let's go... to the race of our destiny!"
Oooh, the most famous
scene in the
movie!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, wait one moment! What was it I
said before?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on. You worry way too much! I
don't need any tactics or
anything!
Because...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We've got the invincible power of our
bond! Just trust it and wait for
my return!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I... I was totally taking it easy before! I
took things for granted, like a
miracle
would just happen on its own!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I've seen the Princess Fighter movie dozens of times! But I forgot such an important thing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Argh! I'm so ashamed I could just smash a
hole in the ground and hide
in it right this
instant!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't been long since we first met. In
Princess Fighter terms... we're
on around
episode six. We've barely gotten started.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right! That's exactly it! In the
beginning, Princess Fighter
doesn't start
out as a perfect princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She hates how training is going and swims
off to a desert island... And
even crushes
the dumbbells given to her by the crafter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But that's when she and the prince talk it
out and understand each
other... They
grow stronger over the course of forty-nine
episodes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm just starting out too, so I'm far from
being Legendary Trainer, but
I'm going to
get there someday with Kawakami
Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do it! We'll follow the way of
the princess together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And I... I want to know more about
you—about my prince!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I mean, there's so much I have no idea
about! Like, what kind of
clothes you like,
or your favorite ramen toppings and
training
equipment!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I definitely will! We'll talk about it
all—everything from our
childhoods to
what our parents are like!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Right... The power of a bond between a
princess and her prince...
That's what'll
truly power up my racing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I feel like I'm about to explode with
energy! Kawakami
Princess... is... baaack!
